results.title: Dominic and the Ladies' Purse
results.overview: Dominic, a disgraced ex-cop turned detective, takes on a seemingly simple case to locate a purse's owner, which unveils a dark web of missing persons, murder, a stalker and the mysterious dancer Nandhita.

results.title: Freedom, Truth, Chaos, Death
results.overview: In 2040, a devastating lung disease has left the world fractured while governments enforce surveillance and control. Amid this unrest, a group of freedom fighters organizes a protest against new pandemic laws. But as the movement grows, shadowy figures begin eliminating people on its margins. Their motives are unknown, their presence undeniable - and their violence threatens to eclipse the resistance itself.

results.title: Hannah Arendt: Eine Jüdin im Pariser Exil
results.original_title: Hannah Arendt: Eine Jüdin im Pariser Exil
results.overview: Hannah Arendt's views on Jewish identity, the Israel-Palestine conflict, and authoritarian-totalitarian systems seem more relevant than ever. Together with biographer Thomas Meyer, this documentary takes us back to the time of her exile in Paris. It was there, on the banks of the Seine, that she laid the foundations for her later works, which would bring her international renown.

results.title: The Stars and the Moon are Holes in the Sky
results.overview: A 40-something disillusioned novelist, Yazoe, haunted by a failed marriage and a crippling personal secret, navigates hollow affairs with a courtesan named Chieko while projecting his emotional void onto the protagonists of his love novels—until an accidental encounter with a naive college student, Noriko Seyawa, unravels his guarded solitude, forcing him to confront his fear of intimacy and the buried trauma shaping his twisted philosophy on love.

results.title: Snakes and Ladders: Child's Play
results.overview: Ahmed meets Malak, and their relationship quickly evolves from mere admiration to mutual love. Each seeks to impress the other with their personality and actions, hoping their love story lasts forever and withstands all challenges.

results.title: SHEEP
results.overview: Short film Wouter De Paepe directed for the song "Sheep" by The Muttons.

results.title: Skin of Sadness
results.overview: A shocking act of violence becomes a unique bond between two lonely men which leads them to discover the meaning of love in most unexpected ways.

results.title: Guilt
results.overview: A man has a nightmare about a past altercation.

results.title: ROH Final Battle 2025
results.overview: Final Battle 2025 was a year-end supershow promoted by Ring of Honor (ROH) that took place on December 5, 2025, at the Greater Columbus Convention Center in Columbus, Ohio, and was headlined by Athena (c) vs. Persephone for the ROH Women's World Title.

results.title: A Normal Woman
results.overview: When an unidentified disease starts to upend her life, a socialite must unravel the mystery behind it — before her whole sense of self falls apart.

results.title: Wizard of Oz: Dead Walk
results.overview: Dorothy is tricked into unleashing Tinman and Scarecrow into the real world only to learn their blood thirsty cravings.

results.title: Mom Tane Nai Samjay
results.overview: Devoted mother Aashka sacrifices her career to raise Meera and Kabir while husband Kunal gets consumed by work. Feeling neglected, she leaves but mentors students needing maternal care. Her absence makes the family realize her worth.

results.title: Concert Anh Trai Vượt Ngàn Chông Gai Day 3 & 4
results.original_title: Concert Anh Trai Vượt Ngàn Chông Gai Day 3 & 4
results.overview: Day 3 and 4 in the series of concerts from the TV show Anh Trai Vượt Ngàn Chông Gai (Call Me by Fire).

results.title: Man Baby
results.overview: When David finds out his girlfriend is pregnant, his penis falls off. To be deemed mature enough to have it reattached, he must complete a 5-step programme of self-improvement whilst simultaneously being stalked by a mysterious creature.

results.title: The Dance of Triumph
results.overview: The story of the post-war life of a veteran of the Second Nagorno-Karabakh War.

results.title: Peppa Meets the Baby Cinema Experience
results.original_title: Peppa Meets the Baby Cinema Experience
results.overview: Join Peppa Pig and her family at the cinema as they get ready for their biggest adventure yet: welcoming a new baby.

results.title: Close The Eye To See
results.overview: Two young university students, Nam and Minh, live together in a small rented apartment. They are lovers. Minh suddenly disappears, leaving Nam soullessly alone in the apartment. Ngọc is their neighbour and the friend who stays by Nam's side to care for and accompany him while he is gradually losing his mind. Everything becomes apparent, and the explanation for Nam's nightmares is revealed.

results.title: Paul & Paulette Take a Bath
results.overview: An unconventional romantic comedy about a young American photographer and a French girl with a taste for the macabre. Paul and Paulette’s chance encounter on a Parisian boulevard sparks an unusual friendship that grows around a dark game; reenacting scenes of notorious crimes from bygone eras at the sites they occurred. As their morbid road trip approaches the more recent past it becomes more uncomfortable, blurring the lines between reality and fantasy, but finding a surprising joy in the darker corners of humanity.
